name: Makalu Expedition
sub_region: Sankhuwasabha District, Koshi Province (Makalu Himal / Mahalangur; Makalu Barun National Park; Nepal-Tibet border)

difficulty.notes: Fifth-highest mountain. Isolated four-sided pyramid. Normal commercial line is the 1955 French route via the Makalu La and northwest face/northeast ridge (saddle with Kangchungtse), with a steep French Couloir and an exposed summit ridge/false summit. SST's 2026 page labels the programme 'NW Ridge'. Operators treat it as more technical than Everest. Four camps above Advance Base Camp; supplemental oxygen is normal. Prior 7,000 m experience is typically required.

duration_days.basis: Full expedition Kathmandu-Kathmandu via Tumlingtar and the Barun valley
duration_days.notes: Seven Summit Treks and several Nepali operators list 50 days (about 12 days walk-in to Lower/Advance BC, rotations, summit window, walk-out). Helicopter to ABC from Khumbu/Chhukung is used by some Western operators and skips the low Barun trek.

max_altitude_point: Makalu Main summit (Himalayan Database 8,485 m; some operators still print 8,463 m)
start_point: Tumlingtar (flight from Kathmandu) then jeep to Num; some teams helicopter to Advance Base Camp

itinerary.route: Arrive Kathmandu; DoT briefing, permits, gear check
Fly Kathmandu - Tumlingtar - jeep to Num
itinerary.notes: Tumlingtar about 450-520 m. Rough road via Khandbari.

itinerary.route: Trek Num - Arun River - Seduwa - Tashigaon
itinerary.notes: Last permanent village. Makalu Barun NP check at Seduwa.

itinerary.route: Tashigaon rest; then steep climb to Khongma Danda
Khongma - Shipton La (about 4,200 m) - Keke La - Dobato - Yangle Kharka - Langmale Kharka
itinerary.notes: Same high traverse as the Makalu Base Camp trek.

itinerary.route: Langmale - Lower / Hillary Base Camp (about 4,850-5,000 m); rest; move to Advance / Higher Base Camp (about 5,600-5,700 m)
itinerary.notes: Himalayan Database altitude milestones: Hillary BC 4,850 m; Advanced BC 5,700 m. SST places ABC at 5,600 m.

itinerary.route: Puja and rotations: ABC - Camp 1 (about 6,100-6,300 m) - Camp 2 (about 6,500-7,000 m) - touch toward Makalu La / Camp 3 - return to ABC
itinerary.notes: Camp altitudes vary widely by operator and year.

itinerary.route: Summit window: Camp 3 on/near Makalu La (about 7,400-7,500 m) - Camp 4 (about 7,600-7,900 m, north ridge) - French Couloir - summit ridge - 8,485 m - descend to C2/ABC
itinerary.notes: Oxygen used by commercial teams. False summit before the pointed true summit.

itinerary.route: Clean ABC/BC; trek out Yangle - Khongma - Tashigaon - Seduwa - Num; jeep Tumlingtar; fly Kathmandu
itinerary.notes: Helicopter ABC-Tumlingtar used by some teams.

best_seasons.notes: Spring is the main commercial season. Autumn expeditions are offered (e.g. SST/Satori). NTB notes the mountain had not had a true-winter ascent as of its Makalu page (not re-verified as a 2026 climbing fact).

permits.name: Department of Tourism climbing royalty - other mountains above 8,000 m (includes Makalu)
permits.fee: USD 3,000 per person spring; USD 1,500 autumn; USD 750 winter/summer

permits.name: Garbage management deposit (refundable, per team) - 8,000 m other ranges / above 8,000 m
permits.fee: USD 3,000 per expedition team (DoT: Khumbu/Annapurna other-8000m USD 3,000; other ranges above 8,000 m also USD 3,000)

permits.name: Makalu Barun National Park entry
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500)

permits.name: Sankhuwasabha restricted area permit (Bhotkhola RM wards 1-5, Makalu RM ward 4)
permits.fee: USD 20 per person per week for the first 4 weeks; USD 25 beyond. Not normally required for the standard Num-Barun walk-in; expedition-permit RAP fee waiver if it does apply is UNVERIFIED.
permits.applies_to: only if the route enters listed restricted wards
permits.status: UNVERIFIED (whether the standard expedition approach enters these wards)

guide_requirements: Sixth Amendment: no solo 8,000 m expeditions; at least one mountain guide or high-altitude worker per two members. Liaison officer. Staff insurance minimums as in _regulations.json. Approach trek is on the NTB Makalu guide/TIMS list for trekkers; climbers hold a mountaineering permit.

flights: Helicopter to/from ABC used by some teams
logistics.notes: Basic lodges to Tashigaon/Khongma; camping or basic lodges in the Barun; full tented ABC. Remoter than Khumbu; rescue is helicopter-dependent.

highlights: Barun valley walk-in and Makalu Barun National Park
Makalu La and French Couloir on the 1955 line
First ascent 15 May 1955: Jean Couzy and Lionel Terray (French expedition led by Jean Franco); further members summited 16-17 May
risks: Technical summit pyramid, false summit and knife-edge ridge
Crevasses between ABC and Camp 2; steep ice to Camp 1
Extreme altitude; fewer commercial teams and thinner rescue cover than Everest
Avalanche/serac on faces other than the normal ridge

acclimatization.notes: SST rotation block is roughly days 15-30, then a summit window. Helicopter-to-ABC programmes acclimatise in Khumbu first (e.g. Chhukung) then fly to ABC.

unverified: Height 8,485 m vs 8,463 m on some operator pages (Himalayan Database notes 8,463 m as a Shangri-La/Kielkowski figure).
Whether the Num-Barun expedition approach enters RAP wards (same UNVERIFIED note as the Makalu Base Camp trek file).
NTB statement that Makalu has no true-winter ascent: page not dated as a 2026 verification.
Permit validity 55 vs 75 days for non-Everest 8,000ers.
